osq1_answer.note: Endpoint has NO auth dependency (speech.py:646-653 — no Depends(require_*)). The app's shared auth-wired Dio attaches a bearer anyway; harmless. No error envelope to pin — there is no 401/403 path.
osq1_answer.response_shape: JSON string literal of the transcript, e.g. "Focus mode voice chat test one two three."

silence_behavior.input: 0.5 s pure silence, PCM16 mono 44100 Hz
silence_behavior.note: Whisper HALLUCINATES on silence — a 200 with non-empty junk text, NOT an empty transcript. AC-S4.2's empty-transcript -> AsrException case must therefore treat hallucination-on-silence as a distinct possibility; an empty recording does not reliably produce an empty transcript.

prefix_param.usage: UNSET for chat replies. Only the legacy GUI client (lupin_client.py:384) sends prefix= for command routing; web notifications client does not use this endpoint.
